Junior Software Engineer (Onsite Casablanca, Morocco)

Junior
Responsibilities

* Participate in the design and development of backend features in collaboration with senior engineers and frontend developers.
* Contribute to event-driven microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Apache Kafka.
* Assist with the development and optimization of Kafka producers, consumers, and Kafka Streams applications.
* Collaborate with the frontend team on React and React Native applications.
* Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of existing applications by fixing bugs and implementing enhancements.
* Assist with the integration, testing, and deployment of new functionalities.
* Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-documented code following software-development best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and continuously improve code quality.
* Contribute to unit, integration, contract, and automated testing activities.
* Use SonarQube and SonarLint to identify and resolve code-quality and security issues.
* Support caching and performance optimization using Redis.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver effective technical solutions.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and project-progress meetings.
* Continuously learn new technologies and share knowledge with the team.

Required

* Engineering degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
